lastResponse.text: This is critical. Call nine one one now. Say: “Possible overdose, not waking up, very slow or strange breathing.” Put him on his side, keep his airway clear, and stay with him. If you have naloxone, give it now. If breathing stops, start CPR. Keep the phone on speaker with nine one one and follow their instructions.
originalTexts: This is critical. Call **911 now**. Say: “Possible overdose, not waking up, very slow or strange breathing.” Put him on his side, keep his airway clear, and stay with him. If you have naloxone, give it now. If breathing stops, start CPR. Keep the phone on speaker with 911 and follow their instructions.
slottedCanonicalQueryTemplates: Wait—hold on—now he’s not really waking up at all, like limp, and his breathing sounds weird.
